<STRUCT_0001>
When taking local cohomology with respect to the maximal ideal
of a local Noetherian ring, we often get the Mittag-Leffler condition
for free. This implies the same thing is true for higher cohomology
groups of an inverse system of coherent sheaves with surjective transition
maps on the puncture spectrum.

Let <MATH_0001> be a Noetherian local ring.
<STRUCT_0001>
<STRUCT_0002> Let <MATH_0002> be a finite <MATH_0003>-module. Then the <MATH_0004>-module
<MATH_0005> satisfies the descending chain condition
for any <MATH_0006>.
<STRUCT_0003> Let <MATH_0007> be the
punctured spectrum of <MATH_0008>.
Let <MATH_0009> be a coherent <MATH_0010>-module.
Then the <MATH_0011>-module <MATH_0012>
satisfies the descending chain condition for <MATH_0013>.
<STRUCT_0004>
